subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “But the class still remembered it.”?
options: The right words can change how people treat the same place.
They are kept because they help people remember what time has taken away.
When old infrastructure loses its first purpose, it may still guide people through history in a new way.
Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The right words can change how people treat the same place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They are kept because they help people remember what time has taken away.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When old infrastructure loses its first purpose, it may still guide people through history in a new way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「But the class still remembered it. Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「But the class still remembered it. Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.」，答案為「Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
